CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n3), its organization/presentation (coordinate listing) and a separate origin/status field are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content-identification entries list colors bound to coordinate sets and referents.

D.rationale: The report separately lists identified content (color at coordinates) and an origin/status field for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report describes how contents are represented/presented (coordinate sets) and includes origin/access metadata tied to the same referents/times.
